messages:
sam: Heads-up — the Go SDK quickstart for generator streaming uses context.Background() for the client in the example, then people try to cancel with request ctx and see goroutine leaks. Repro in sample app.

maria: Yep saw that too. The example is ambiguous. We should show using the request ctx and an explicit cancel tied to a timeout. Something like:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
client := redwood.NewClient(apiKey, redwood.WithContext(ctx))
gen := client.Generator(ctx, req)
defer gen.Close()
for gen.Next() { /* handle token */ }
```
That makes cancellation semantics clear and prevents leftover goroutines.

jun: Small API ergonomics note: the Go generator type exposes Close() but other streaming types use CloseStream()/Shutdown() in docs. We should prefer a consistent Close() method across streaming types so examples line up. Also docs should mention calling gen.Close() in a defer immediately after creation.

tyler: Another angle — our auth/retry backoff loop currently does long sleeps and doesn't select on ctx.Done(), so even if user cancels the ctx the retry sleep blocks for the backoff duration. That amplifies the leak. I pushed a minimal change to the retry package to select on ctx.Done() during jitter backoff.

sam: Filed issue #3421 with a tiny repro and a pprof showing goroutine stacks. Repro uses this sample app: https://github.com/redwood/sample-go-gen-ctx-leak — steps in the issue.

maria: Thanks — I'll open a docs PR to replace the quickstart snippet and call out the common pitfall: "do not use context.Background() for request-scoped clients/streams". Maybe add a short sidebar: "When in doubt, prefer ctx from request and set a timeout." :memo:

jun: Can we also add a unit/integration test that asserts a canceled generator doesn't leave goroutines? E.g., start gen, cancel ctx, wait <100ms and assert goroutine count drops back down. Helps catch regressions.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed for branch fix/ctx-cancel-backoff (build #4521) :rocket:

tyler: I'll open the docs PR + link the retry patch and the issue. cc @maria @jun. Thanks for the quick triage — feels like a 2PR fix (retry + docs) with a small test.

maria: sounds good. once PRs land we'll swap the quickstart in the site and add a short note to the migration guide for generator ergonomics.

sam: great — appreciate the quick responses. I'll post the sample app update and a reproducible test case in the issue.
